No experiment substitutes for an infinite-limit proof.

value.rationale: A conservative reversible exchange is the minimal natural physical test of both nonnegative populations and conserved total mass. The exact result identifies a complete, all-positive-start obstruction to uniform mass control under every fixed finite sweep, quantifies species parity and exponential towers, and distinguishes strong stiffness defects from both scalar L-stability and local equilibrium linearization. This is a structural stress test, not just a one-parameter calculation or a finite experiment.
